title: the-liveness-tool-defines-the-ruled-cadence
intention: The liveness tool defines the ruled heartbeat cadence CADENCE_S = 60.0 (Akien 2026-08-22) beside the staleness threshold it already sets, so any component can read the beat interval through the tool's public interface instead of reaching into the cairn device.
why: RULE 1 (encapsulation, Akien 2026-10-01): every component talks to another only through its public interface; a ticket's build lives inside its own component and its proofs and hollow measure only that component. The ruled cadence was spelled inside the cairn device, and launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py:59 reached in for it — one of 80 encapsulation_breaches measured 2026-10-05. Split from 48c0c58a1714 at Akien's word, 2026-10-05: "we said that devices never cross boundaries, that's why we're making these changes. and we said that then we'd only have to run the tests for the changed files and not for all files."
how: cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py gains CADENCE_S = 60.0 with the ruling's provenance directly above the staleness threshold's comment block, and STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S becomes 5 * CADENCE_S (value unchanged, 300.0). One new proof in cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/, already written red.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) cairn.tools.liveness.liveness.CADENCE_S == 60.0; (2) STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S == 5 * CADENCE_S. RED if either fails or test_liveness_is_a_tool.py goes red. WRONG INTENT if the cadence is the ground loop's private tuning rather than a ruled number other components legitimately need.
watchme: none, because the build_inspector's encapsulation_breaches sieve (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py) already reds any new reach across a component boundary on every inspection
children: none, because the change is one component's edit plus its one proof, already on disk at cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_tool_defines_the_ruled_cadence.py

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py, immediately above line 40 (which reads '# THE STALENESS THRESHOLD — RULED by Akien 2026-07-31 (recorded on the ticket):'), insert exactly these four lines followed by one blank line: '# THE CADENCE — RULED by Akien 2026-08-22: the ground loop beats once per minute.' / '# This is the ONE class-space definition site; the ground loop and every proof that needs' / '# the beat interval import it from here (RULE 1: nothing reaches into the cairn device for it).' / 'CADENCE_S = 60.0'. Each comment line starts with '# '.

D2: SETTLED: in cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py, change the line `STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S = 300.0` to `STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S = 5 * CADENCE_S`. The comment block above it is unchanged. Nothing else in the file changes.

D3: SETTLED: the proof cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_tool_defines_the_ruled_cadence.py already stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 2/2 at HEAD (2026-10-05: AttributeError, no CADENCE_S). It is committed at the BUILDME crossing; D1-D2 turn it green and do not edit it.

D4: SETTLED: after D1-D2 run the new proof (exit 0, 2/2) and cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_liveness_is_a_tool.py (exit as before). Commit cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py alone naming c3b14029d6d8, letting the pre-commit reseal door reseal. No file outside cairn/tools/liveness changes.

D5: SETTLED: run each proof from the repo root with python3: 'python3 cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_tool_defines_the_ruled_cadence.py' (must exit 0, 2 passed) and 'python3 cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_liveness_is_a_tool.py' (must exit as it did before the edit). Then seal with 'bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 1200 cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_tool_defines_the_ruled_cadence.py'.

D6: SETTLED: the commit stages cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py alone and its message's first line is 'c3b14029d6d8: the liveness tool defines the ruled cadence' (the ticket id, a colon, a space, then the summary), followed by the Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session trailer lines.

D7: SETTLED: the baseline was measured 2026-10-05 at HEAD 87b9a1b6: 'python3 cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_liveness_is_a_tool.py' printed '3 passed, 0 failed out of 3' and exited 0. After the edit it must print the same and exit 0.

D8: SETTLED: the commit message is exactly three parts: line 1 'c3b14029d6d8: the liveness tool defines the ruled cadence', one blank line, then the two trailer lines the building session's harness supplies. For this build they are 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' and 'Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JrhBQALF5qFBEVqQJUsXUu'. The trailers carry authorship only; no gate reads them.

D9: SETTLED (corrects D3's 'committed at the BUILDME crossing'): the proof test_the_tool_defines_the_ruled_cadence.py was already committed, unchanged, in 87b9a1b6 (2026-10-05) and is not touched again. The build commit stages exactly one file, cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py; 'git show --stat HEAD' after it lists only that file (plus any history.json/state.json/.artifact-journal.jsonl the commit hooks add).
